svg.title: 04 | End-to-end disaster recovery and controlled cutover
svg.desc: Recovery begins with authority and fencing, not restoring a database into an active service. Each gate can stop cutover; keys and platform dependencies must be available before controlled service starts.

g.title: G
g.text: 04 | End-to-end disaster recovery and controlled cutover

g.title: incident
g.text: record T0, scope, legal estate and decision owner

g.title: fence
g.text: Contain and fence old writers / runtimes

g.title: choose
g.text: choose PITR target before corruption if available

g.title: infra
g.text: DNS / routing isolated, storage, TLS / CA
trusted recovery identities and key quorum

g.title: restore
g.text: Restore SQL + matched evidence / source / config
restore required Redis under separate policy

g.title: stop
g.text: quarantine, remediate or choose another cohort

g.title: integrity
g.text: schema, owner links, chain / manifest verification

g.title: reconcile
g.text: Reconcile SQL jobs / attempts / budgets / outbox
identify UNKNOWN external work; fence again

g.title: replay
g.text: renew authentication / invalidate stale state as required

g.title: smoke
g.text: Restricted API / UI smoke and negative tests
current proof, source and cleanup checks

g.title: approve
g.text: accept measured loss and service limitations

g.title: cutover
g.text: progressive admission; only approved new work

g.title: failback
g.text: replicate all new writes; fence former active side
no old backup rollback after accepting new writes
